video_metadata.title: I Tried Influencer Recommended Skincare 🤯Products- Dr. Bhagyashree | Gauri Gajare Official
video_metadata.description:
Hey everyone!!
I Tried Influencer Recommended Skincare Products- Dr. Bhagyashree and THIS HAPPENED!!

I have been following Dr Bhagyashree's content for a while now and I must say her recommendations look very promising. But did her holy grail products live up to the hype? Let's find out together! 💄💅
My acne situation was getting worse and I knew I need to change a few things in my skincare to better my skin. 
COSRX Snail Mucin kept popping in my feed and I took it as a sign to go ahead and finally try it out.
Saslic DS Facewash was another one that caught my eye and when Dr Bhagyashree mentioned these products, I knew it was time I get these.
I wouldn't recommend to try out everything you see online. Make sure to do your own research and ask the right questions.
I tried these products and have shared my very honest feedback on these so that you don't have to think twice.

👍 **Like, Share, and Subscribe for more skincare adventures!**

Link to purchase the Saslic DS Facewash:

https://www.wishlink.com/share/qbm5d

Link to purchase COSRX Snail Mucin:

Nykaa: https://www.wishlink.com/share/5t8v7
